objs.name: document
objs.description: A document in P&R Management system such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction.

objs.name: documenttype
objs.description: Type of document (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

objs.name: template
objs.description: Template used when creating new documents.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Attachment (Equipment) linked to a Document; attachments may trigger versioning.

objs.name: additionalinfo
objs.description: Additional information attached to a Document that is not subject to the main release cycle.

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: Proposed changes linked to a Document.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: Distribution list associated with a Document for notification and acknowledgement.

evts.name: createdocument
evts.description: A document is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: editdocument
evts.description: Document content or properties are edited, potentially creating a new version.

evts.name: releasedocument
evts.description: Document release process with a 3-step workflow and electronic signatures.

evts.name: attachequipment
evts.description: Attach Equipment to a Document (Attachment) and trigger versioning.

evts.name: createchangeproposal
evts.description: Create a ChangeProposal for a Document.

evts.name: applychangeproposal
evts.description: Apply a ChangeProposal to a Document.

evts.name: extendvalidity
evts.description: Extend the validity period of a Document (and related attachments) via workflow.

evts.name: override
evts.description: Override/AKS process to invalidate and archive a Document.

evts.name: reactivatedocument
evts.description: Reactivate an invalidated Document and restore its state.

evts.name: archivedocument
evts.description: Archive a Document after invalidation or end of lifecycle.

evts.name: distributedocument
evts.description: Distribute a released Document to distribution lists or groups.

evts.name: translatedocument
evts.description: Translate a released Document and release the translation with workflow support.

o2o.description: Document uses Template when creating new Document instances
Document has Attachment (Equipment) linked to it
